deferredDecisions.reason: Redis and derived ranking are already documented as projections or transport support. No production read/write, hit-rate, latency, or eviction evidence is checked into this repository to justify a new cache layer or TTL policy.

Matching shard expansion, feed CQRS and richer video ranking need observed traffic and SLO evidence. The current code keeps the documented bounded algorithms rather than adding speculative infrastructure.

The backend report contract and web API hook remain, but the visible report action was deliberately removed from the current reel UI. Do not claim the client feature is implemented until a product decision re-enables it and a behavior test verifies the user action.
